name: Olimpbet
verdict: Operated by ООО «БК «Олимп», 97.5% held by ООО «Зевс» of private individuals A. Petukhov and D. Denisova (50/50). Nothing found.
note: Russian bookmaker, brand of the licensed operator ООО "БК "Олимп" (ИНН 7726705980). Official partner of HC Spartak Moscow and several other KHL clubs (CSKA, Severstal, Sochi, Amur). Ownership traced to private individuals via EGRUL data (RusProfile); no human-rights findings against the company or owners identified.
